Alistar.watch: Alistar W Headbutt charges in and knocks Janna or an ally back. If Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample follow, it is difficult to escape. The moment Alistar engages, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt him. Near a turret, do not give Alistar room to circle behind you and knock you toward the inside of the turret.
Alistar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Alistar's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Alistar.fight: When Alistar engages, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Reposition and counterattack right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and wait out its duration.
Alistar.laning: Save Janna Q Howling Gale for situations where your ADC would actually be hit, and release it immediately when Alistar engages. Time Janna E Eye Of The Storm for when damage is about to land, and do not use Q or Janna W Zephyr for meaningless poke or clearing minions. Do not walk alone through areas without vision; check in advance which direction Alistar may engage from.
Alistar.combo: Immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale when Alistar engages with Alistar W Headbutt, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when an ally is about to take damage, and knock Alistar back with Janna R Monsoon if the engage continues. New knockups still affect Alistar after he activates Alistar R Unbreakable Will, so if you cannot retreat, interrupt him again with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Alistar.escape: Right after Alistar W Headbutt is used is a window when he cannot engage without a mobility ability. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, use that time to close the distance and counterattack, or move back to a safe position.
Alistar.phase: In the early game, Janna should focus on preventing Alistar's engages and staying alive rather than starting fights to get kills. In the mid game, protect allies with shields and healing. In the late game, give allied damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Alistar.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealers and interrupt Alistar's engage with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon as soon as he goes in. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, do not spend abilities attacking Alistar; back off. Spend your time protecting allied damage dealers and creating chances to target the damage dealers behind him instead of trying to kill Alistar.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so do not stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Bard can flank with Bard E Magical Journey, so watch the engage direction and save Janna Q Howling Gale. Do not rush attacks while Bard R Tempered Fate has made a target immune to damage.
Bard.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance, and prepare for situations where Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns you and you take focused attacks.
Bard.fight: Immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt Bard when he walks in or engages with Bard E Magical Journey. Then slow him with Janna W Zephyr to end the trade, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm just as damage is about to land.
Bard.combo: Right after Bard E Magical Journey is used, close the distance and knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Follow with Janna W Zephyr to keep him slowed, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when the counterattack damage is about to land.
Bard.escape: Right after making Bard use Bard E Magical Journey is a window to go in again. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, close the distance while avoiding the stun threat, and use Janna Q Howling Gale to prevent Bard from escaping.
Bard.phase: In the early game, Janna should focus on stopping Bard's engages and protecting the ADC rather than getting kills. In the late game, play to give allied damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Bard.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealers and watch the direction Bard may engage from. Knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale as soon as he goes in. Just before a damage dealer is caught, knock Bard back and heal with Janna R Monsoon; if you need to retreat immediately, give up the heal and move.
Bard.laning: If Bard W Caretaker's Shrine is visible in lane, walk over it to remove it. Save Janna Q Howling Gale for when your ADC is actually in danger instead of using it for meaningless poke.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley spreads wide and slows, so dodge it by moving sideways. Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed with each basic attack, so do not stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow flies in a straight line and stuns, so do not start a skirmish from out of vision while her ultimate is available, and move while watching its direction.
Ashe.fight: Try to trade right after Ashe W Volley is used. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, and knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale when an ally reaches her after it ends. Do not chase far on foot, so you are not exposed to Ashe's basic attack slow for long.
Ashe.laning: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and time Janna E Eye Of The Storm for when an ally is actually about to take damage. Do not use Janna Q Howling Gale for meaningless poke; save it for the moment the enemy engages. Limit roams to when the wave has been safely pushed or your allied ADC has recalled.
Ashe.combo: After Ashe W Volley is used and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus ends, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to knock her up when an ally closes the distance. Then slow her with Janna W Zephyr, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when an ally is about to take damage. To charge the tornado longer, hide it behind a wall or in a bush and wait for Ashe to enter its path.
Ashe.escape: When Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and Ashe W Volley are down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended, there is an opportunity to close the distance with your allies. Ashe has no way to create distance on her own, so when an ally reaches her, catch her with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Ashe.phase: Janna has a hard time getting kills in the early game, so focus on dodging Ashe W Volley and protecting your allied ADC. Shields and healing become more valuable in the mid game, and in the late game focus on giving allied damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Ashe.teamfight: Beside your allied damage dealers, avoid positions where you could be exposed to Ashe's slow and stun for long. If the enemy engages on an ally, knock them up with Janna Q Howling Gale or push them back with Janna R Monsoon, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when damage is about to land. If your allies get a chance to reach Ashe, use Janna Q Howling Gale to keep her from escaping.

Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite hits the first enemy it reaches, so stand behind minions and avoid the moment when a gap between minions leaves you facing Braum in a straight line. If Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, move out of range before stun stacks build up. Watch Braum R Glacial Fissure's cast animation and dodge sideways, and do not step into the slowing zone it leaves behind.
Braum.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Braum's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first.
Braum.fight: When Braum walks in, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. If Braum E Unbreakable is up, do not fire projectiles from the front; wait for his shield to drop or for an angle from the side. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used, look for a chance to catch him with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Braum.laning: Janna should focus on interrupting Braum's engage beside the ADC. Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions, and save Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr for situations where your ADC would actually be hit. Even during a turret dive, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale when the enemy goes in.
Braum.combo: When Braum engages, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage is about to land to protect the ally, and if Braum keeps sticking to them and they are in danger, push him back with Janna R Monsoon.
Braum.escape: Right after making Braum use Braum W Stand Behind Me is a window to close the distance. If you are marked in a way that could lead to Braum's stun, do not go in; move out of range before the stacks are complete. Dodge Braum R Glacial Fissure too, then look for an opening to engage.
Braum.phase: In the early game, Janna should focus on stopping Braum's engages and staying alive rather than getting kills. In the mid game, protect allies with shields and healing. In the late game, help teamfights by increasing the time allied damage dealers stay alive.
Braum.teamfight: Wait beside your allied damage dealers for Braum to engage, then interrupt him with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. Position yourself to avoid Braum R Glacial Fissure's line and the slowing zone it leaves behind. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking projectiles from the front, help your allies deal damage when his shield drops or an angle opens from the side.

Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear first to make it easier to prevent stacks of Brand P Blaze and its detonation. If you’re on fire, get out of the path of Brand Q Sear’s projectile or stand behind a minion to avoid the stun. Brand E Conflagration spreads around burning targets, and Brand R Pyroclasm bounces between enemies, so spread out from allies when you see either ability being cast.
Brand.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Most of Brand’s damage is magic, and Janna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.fight: The moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close the distance. Brand has no mobility, so when an ally goes in, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to keep him there. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in to help with the trade.
Brand.laning: Step to the side of the wave, since Brand E Conflagration can spread from burning minions. When Brand tries to hit your ADC with a spell, cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm, and immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt an enemy who dives in. Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr cost a lot of mana, so don’t waste them on meaningless poke.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and there is no active burn effect, use Janna Q Howling Gale to knock Brand up as an ally closes the distance, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. If an ally catches Brand with an immobilizing effect, you can also release a Janna Q Howling Gale charged out of vision onto him.
Brand.phase: Janna is weak at securing kills early, so focus on dodging Brand’s poke and protecting your ADC. In the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Brand.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealers, but keep some distance from them so Brand E Conflagration and Brand R Pyroclasm don’t spread. If an enemy goes in on an ally, knock them away with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in. If you need Janna R Monsoon’s healing, stay still after casting; if you need to dodge immediately, give up the healing and move.
Brand.escape: The moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is the window to engage. Brand has no mobility, and Brand Q Sear does not stun when Blaze is absent, so confirm that and close the distance.

Blitzcrank.watch: If you’re pulled by Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, it can be followed by the knockup from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Stand with minions between you and Blitzcrank, and stay far from bushes when you don’t have vision of them. If Blitzcrank walks toward you, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt his engage.
Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity is also important because getting hooked can lead to a chain of crowd control.
Blitzcrank.fight: Look to trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when he runs out of mana. If Blitzcrank walks toward you, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Even if Blitzcrank’s health decreases, he gains Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier, so don’t go deep without a way to finish him.
Blitzcrank.laning: Always stand behind minions to block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Keep bushes warded, and don’t walk alone into areas without vision. Save Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr for situations where your ADC would actually be hit; when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, gain an advantage by pushing the lane or trading.
Blitzcrank.combo: If Blitzcrank approaches, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in, and use Janna R Monsoon to push Blitzcrank away if he reaches an ally. Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, so don’t rely on Janna E Eye Of The Storm alone to withstand his engage.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to move up and trade. You can also close the distance when Blitzcrank runs out of mana and can’t use his hook. Keep your distance if Blitzcrank E Power Fist or Blitzcrank R Static Field is still available, since either can follow up after he catches you.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Wait beside your allied damage dealers for Blitzcrank to engage, then push him away with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon. If you need Janna R Monsoon’s healing, hold your position after casting; if you need to retreat immediately, give up the healing and move. Focus on protecting your allied damage dealers and giving them time to deal with enemies farther back in the enemy formation, rather than fixating only on Blitzcrank.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, prioritize dodging Blitzcrank's hook; Janna's goal is to shut down the enemy engage. In mid game, as support items stack up, shields and healing become more valuable. Late game, help teamfights by keeping your carries alive longer.

Heimerdinger.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Heimerdinger’s turret, rocket, and grenade damage are all magic, so build magic resistance.
Heimerdinger.laning: Don’t stay for long within Heimerdinger’s turret setup; pressure Heimerdinger himself into backing away. Hold Janna Q Howling Gale until you need to interrupt an engage, and use Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage hits an ally. Don’t walk alone into areas without vision; ward bushes and jungle entrances.
Heimerdinger.combo: When you get a chance to approach Heimerdinger, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm to shield an ally as damage comes in, and use Janna R Monsoon if you need to push Heimerdinger away.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no mobility, so go around his turret setup to approach and hit him with Janna Q Howling Gale. If you get hit by his grenade, immediately leave turret range.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Janna is better off surviving by disrupting Heimerdinger’s turret pressure and engages than trying to secure kills. In the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: When an enemy goes in on an ally, knock them away with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in.
Heimerdinger.fight: Close the distance just after a turret has been placed or has finished a powerful shot, and hit Heimerdinger himself, who has no mobility ability, with Janna Q Howling Gale.

Karma.watch: Getting hit by Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve brings Karma R Mantra back sooner through Karma P Gathering Fire, so stand behind minions or outside her range. If you’re hit by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra, move out of the circle before the lingering zone detonates. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away to break the tether before you’re rooted.
Karma.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Karma’s magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. If Karma can lock down your allied damage dealer and burst them, buy Mikael’s Blessing earlier, since Janna E Eye Of The Storm cannot remove crowd control that has already been applied.
Karma.fight: If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, closing the distance first can get you caught, so keep your distance and make her use it. If the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra is active, fight after it expires. When Karma approaches, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale to knock her up and slow her with Janna W Zephyr to interrupt the trade.
Karma.laning: Save Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr for when your ADC is actually in danger, and dodge Karma’s poke from behind minions or outside her range. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as Karma Q Inner Flame hits to make use of the shield duration. Ward bushes and entrances, but don’t walk alone into areas without vision.
Karma.combo: If Karma walks toward you, immediately release Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr to create distance. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has expired, you can release a Janna Q Howling Gale charged behind a bush or wall along Karma’s path. Karma may back away if she hears the tornado charging, so watch for that reaction too.
Karma.phase: Early on, Janna should focus on dodging Karma’s poke and stopping her engages rather than trying to secure kills. In the mid game, protect allies with support item shields and healing; later, focus on giving allied damage dealers more time to stay alive.
Karma.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealers and watch for Karma W Focused Resolve to catch someone. When Karma goes in, knock her away with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. If Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra shields nearby enemies, delay your engage until the shields expire. To heal with Janna R Monsoon, hold your position after casting; if you need to retreat right away, move after the knockback.
Karma.escape: Janna's chance to engage comes when Karma W Focused Resolve is down, so you don't have to worry about being rooted. After Karma E Inspire's movement speed boost and shield, and the shield empowered by Karma R Mantra, have been used, wait for their duration to end before closing the distance.

Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and attaches Leona to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allied carry. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch your distance and back away rather than waiting to see whether she uses a skill. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.
Leona.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to help you survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to counter Leona’s damage, while also considering the damage type of the enemy carry who attacks while Leona holds someone in place. If your allied carry is likely to die while locked down by crowd control, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Leona.fight: When Leona walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock her up, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. When Leona W Eclipse is active, move out of range before it explodes. Close the distance and counterattack immediately after Leona E Zenith Blade is used.
Leona.laning: In lane, focus on stopping Leona’s engage. Don’t stand in a line with your allied carry, and save Janna Q Howling Gale for when someone is actually at risk of being engaged on. Don’t walk alone into areas without vision, and check in advance where Leona might engage from.
Leona.combo: When Leona engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as soon as your allied carry takes damage, and if Leona’s engage connects, knock her back with Janna R Monsoon.
Leona.escape: The moment after Leona E Zenith Blade is used is your chance to close the distance or pick Leona off. Hit her with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Keep your distance while Leona still has crowd control available.
Leona.phase: Early on, watch out for Leona’s chain crowd control and focus on staying alive. In the mid game, protect your allies with shields and healing; in the late game, give your allied carry time to survive and attack.
Leona.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and wait for Leona to engage, then knock her back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. If a Leona P Sunlight mark is applied, that signals incoming follow-up damage, so back away instead of moving forward. When retreating, position yourself ahead in the direction of retreat so your allies can move toward you.

Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy prevents you from using skills and attacks, so don’t close the distance while it’s available. Avoid the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance, and if Lulu R Wild Growth is available, don’t focus all your attacks at once on the target it protects.
Lulu.fight: When Lulu walks in to poke, cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. After Lulu W Whimsy is used, look for a chance to close the distance and knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and pressure her with steady poke instead of forcing an engage. Don’t waste Janna Q Howling Gale on meaningless poke; save it for when Lulu or her partner actually engages.
Lulu.combo: When the enemy engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock them up, then slow them with Janna W Zephyr. If Lulu W Whimsy has been used and you can hide the tornado behind a brush or wall, charge Janna Q Howling Gale and fire it when Lulu steps into its path.
Lulu.escape: The moment after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally is your chance to close the distance. Even then, Janna has no skill to escape on her own, so watch your range as you go in to avoid the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance and the knock-up from Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.phase: Janna has a hard time getting kills early, so maintain your distance and vision and stop the enemy’s engages. In the late game, focus on giving your allied carry time to survive and attack.
Lulu.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and interrupt the engage of the target Lulu is protecting with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, don’t expect to secure a kill on the target it protects; go for Lulu herself or another target. After knocking someone back with Janna R Monsoon, stay in place if you need the healing, and move immediately if you need to get out.
Lulu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu's damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but base your later resistance choices on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting as well.

Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by the root or pull from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you can take all the follow-up damage, so don’t move in ahead of your team while that skill is available. If Hwei’s first skill hits you, move immediately to avoid the second skill and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Take a wide route around areas covered by Hwei Q Subject: Disaster and narrow passages.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to help you survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Janna has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If your allied carry is likely to die after being rooted, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier, since Janna E Eye Of The Storm can’t remove crowd control that has already been applied.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is your chance to close the distance. Slow him with Janna W Zephyr, then knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale to give your ally time to attack. Use Janna E Eye Of The Storm for protection as Hwei’s damage comes in.
Hwei.laning: Focus on preventing Hwei’s skills from hitting in succession rather than forcing kills. Don’t waste Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr on meaningless poke; use them when your allied carry is actually about to get hit. Don’t walk alone into areas without vision, and secure vision around the mid lane and jungle entrances.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, approach with Janna W Zephyr to slow him, then knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm for protection when retaliatory damage comes in. If Hwei is engaging, reverse the order: immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no skill to create distance, so the moment after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment is your window to engage. If that skill is still available, whoever leads the engage could be rooted or forced back, so wait. Approach while avoiding Hwei’s ground effects and eye.
Hwei.phase: Janna is weak at getting kills early, so survive Hwei’s poke without taking repeated hits. In the mid game, shields and healing become more valuable; in the late game, focus on giving your allied carry time to survive and attack.
Hwei.teamfight: Rather than stepping forward to start a fight, stay beside your allied carry and watch for angles where Hwei E Subject: Torment could catch them. If Hwei’s first skill hits, help your ally reposition to avoid follow-up hits, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in. If an enemy gets on your ally, knock them back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and continue healing with Janna R Monsoon when you can stand safely.

Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in a line with your ally. Bait Lux into using Lux Q, then dodge sideways. Walk out of the area affected by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and move sideways when you see the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark. If a Lux skill hits you and applies Lux P Illumination, keep your distance to avoid the empowered basic attack.
Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to help you survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, so Janna should build magic resistance first. If your allied carry is likely to die while rooted by Lux Q Light Binding, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier, since Janna E Eye Of The Storm can’t remove the root.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it, then close the distance. Lux has no mobility skill, so once you’re close, slow her with Janna W Zephyr and knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale to continue the trade. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in to use the shield.
Lux.laning: Stand spread out beside your ally so you don’t both get caught by Lux Q Light Binding. Don’t waste Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr on meaningless poke; use them when your ADC is actually at risk of being hit or to trade after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Don’t walk alone into areas without vision, and secure vision in brushes and along the approaches.
Lux.combo: When Lux Q Light Binding misses, approach, slow her with Janna W Zephyr, then knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as Lux’s damage hits your ally, and if the enemy is engaging, fire Janna Q Howling Gale immediately without charging it.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding is used is your window to engage. Lux has no skill or mobility to create distance, so close in and knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Lux.phase: Janna is weak at killing opponents early, so focus on protecting your ADC while dodging Lux Q Light Binding. In the mid game, shields and healing become more valuable; in the late game, focus on giving your allied carry time to survive and attack.
Lux.teamfight: Stay beside your allied carry and knock enemies back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon as they engage. Don’t approach clumped together with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t trap all of you at once. Use Janna E Eye Of The Storm to block damage to an ally rooted by Lux Q Light Binding, but if the root is likely to kill them, remove it with Mikael's Blessing.

Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance can lock down Janna and set her up to take Maokai Q Bramble Smash's slow and area damage, so keep your distance while his W is ready. Don’t enter brush with Maokai E Sapling Toss saplings in it, and dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp at a right angle to its path when it comes from far away.
Maokai.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to prepare for Maokai’s damage, but account for the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Maokai holds someone in place when choosing your resistances. Rush Mikael's Blessing if an allied damage dealer is likely to die while rooted.
Maokai.fight: Don’t enter Maokai W Twisted Advance’s range first while it’s ready. Right after he uses W, move forward and help trade by slowing the enemy damage dealer with Janna W Zephyr. If you keep hitting Maokai with abilities, Maokai P Sap Magic heals more often, so use poke abilities on the enemy damage dealer.
Maokai.laning: Wait beside your ADC for Maokai to engage, and immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt him as he walks in. While Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, stay out of range near brush, and don’t enter alone if you lack vision of the brush. Save Q and Janna W Zephyr for when your ADC is actually at risk of being hit.
Maokai.escape: Your opening to move forward is right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is used. Slow him with Janna W Zephyr and hit him with Janna Q Howling Gale to make it hard for him to escape. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is ready, also check that you have room to dodge its wall of brambles before going in.
Maokai.teamfight: Wait beside your allied damage dealer for Maokai to engage. If Maokai W Twisted Advance lands and locks down an ally, push him away with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in. Take fights in open terrain so there’s room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp.
Maokai.combo: When Maokai walks in, immediately cast Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to cut off the trade. While Maokai is dashing with W Twisted Advance, don't waste targeted attacks; respond after he lands. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm the moment an ally is hit, and knock Maokai back with Janna R Monsoon if he gets close and forces a fight.
Maokai.phase: In the early game, watch for Maokai W Twisted Advance engages, and focus on protecting your ADC rather than starting fights. In the mid game, make use of support items, shields, and healing. In the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to attack while staying alive.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns you and leaves you vulnerable to follow-up attacks, so walk to the side to dodge when you see its landing indicator. Nami R Tidal Wave travels from far away but is slow, so move aside as soon as you see it and watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows. Don’t fight head-on against an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; wait for its duration to end.
Nami.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami’s damage is mostly magic, and Janna’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Nami.fight: The moment Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to target her. If you’ve closed the distance, knock Nami up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in to take the trade.
Nami.laning: If Nami catches you, you can easily be hit by follow-up attacks, so manage your distance first. Even if you see an opening to target Nami, don’t walk alone into an area without vision; get vision in brush and along approach routes. Save Janna Q Howling Gale for when Nami or the enemy ranged damage dealer goes in and your ally is about to be hit, then fire it immediately.
Nami.combo: If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, approach her, hit her with Janna Q Howling Gale, and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. When an ally is attacked, protect them by casting Janna E Eye Of The Storm at that moment. Charge Janna Q Howling Gale behind brush or a wall only when they can hide the tornado, then fire when Nami enters its path.
Nami.escape: Move toward Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Nami has no ability to create distance on her own, so hitting her with Janna Q Howling Gale once you’re close gives you a chance to catch her. If an enemy is affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, engage again after its duration ends.
Nami.phase: Janna has little kill pressure early, so keep your distance and focus on stopping Nami’s engage and stun. Shields and healing become more valuable in the mid game. In the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Nami.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealer and watch for combinations of Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave. Push enemies away with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon as they go in. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when your ally takes damage, and keep Janna R Monsoon’s healing going if you can safely hold your position.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits and slows enemies in an area, so be careful of this ability when approaching Milio. While Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy ADC’s range, delay front-line trades.
Milio.build: Weather the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick deal magic damage, and Janna’s magic resistance is relatively low, so magic resistance is the first resistance to build.
Milio.fight: Close the distance when Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, slow him with Janna W Zephyr, then knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Time Janna E Eye Of The Storm to the moment damage comes in.
Milio.laning: When an enemy goes in on your ADC, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale and slow them with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Delay fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire increases the enemy’s attack range, and in the early game, drain Milio’s mana through attrition and take control of the wave. Don’t use Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr for meaningless poke or to clear minions.
Milio.combo: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, slow him with Janna W Zephyr and knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale. If you don’t need to interrupt an immediate engage, charge Janna Q Howling Gale hidden behind a wall or in brush, then fire when Milio enters its path.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is Milio’s only way to disengage, so after he uses it, you have a chance to approach him. Close the distance and knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale; Milio R Breath of Life cannot remove the airborne effect.
Milio.phase: Janna has little kill pressure early, so focus on draining Milio’s mana and taking control of the wave. Milio’s composition also gets stronger over time, so in the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Milio.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealer and push enemies back with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon as they go in. Delay front-line trades while Milio W Cozy Campfire increases the enemy damage dealer’s range. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and you can approach him, you can also choose to target Milio first, since he has no mobility and low defensive stats.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so keep minions between you and dodge it. Don’t stay within basic attack range, to avoid being hit by the first attack from Nautilus P Staggering Blow. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don’t stand on top of allies.
Nautilus.build: Nautilus’s main damage is magic, and Janna’s magic resistance is low, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rush Mikael's Blessing if an allied damage dealer is likely to die while locked down.
Nautilus.fight: Trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. If Nautilus walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, slow him with Janna W Zephyr, then create distance. Time Janna E Eye Of The Storm to the moment damage comes in.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block the angle for Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and save Janna Q Howling Gale until your ADC is actually in danger. Even during a tower dive, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale as Nautilus goes in. Don’t walk alone into areas without vision; get vision along approach routes.
Nautilus.combo: As Nautilus engages with Q Dredge Line, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt him, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the follow-up damage comes in, and push Nautilus away with Janna R Monsoon if he reaches your ally and the fight is about to continue.
Nautilus.teamfight: Wait beside your allied damage dealer for Nautilus to engage, then push him away with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon. Don’t overlap with allies along the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge. If an allied damage dealer is about to die while crowd controlled, prioritize cleansing them with Mikael's Blessing.
Nautilus.escape: The window to close in and trade is when Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses or just after he uses it. Knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr, and back away without lingering in basic attack range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow.
Nautilus.phase: In the early game, Janna should focus on shutting down Nautilus's engages and staying alive rather than starting fights. Late game, help teamfights by keeping your carries alive longer.

Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks can easily land, so keep minions between you and her. When your health is low, don't walk through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, get out of range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to raise your magic resistance, then choose Mercury's Treads. If an allied damage dealer caught by Morgana Q Dark Binding is likely to die to focused attacks, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier. If a long fight makes healing from Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow a problem, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistance.
Morgana.fight: Stay far enough away to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. If an enemy walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale and slow them with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Don't waste Janna Q Howling Gale on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. Look for a chance to poke after Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down.
Morgana.laning: Keep the wave between you and Morgana so minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding. Don't use Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr for meaningless poke or to clear minions; save them for when an allied damage dealer is actually under attack. Don't walk alone into areas without vision. Ward bushes and approaches so you can see Morgana's entry route early.
Morgana.combo: If Morgana engages without her shield, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock her up, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Protect your allied damage dealer with Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in. If Morgana E Black Shield is active, wait until it is gone before using Janna Q Howling Gale.
Morgana.escape: Only move forward to respond with Janna W Zephyr or Janna Q Howling Gale while Morgana Q Dark Binding has missed and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Janna has no skill to escape on her own, so don't go deep even during that window; stay within range to return to your allied damage dealer.
Morgana.phase: Early on, Janna should focus on dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding and stopping engages rather than getting kills. Late game, focus on giving allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Morgana.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealer and watch for Morgana Q Dark Binding. When the enemy engages, knock them back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. Don't waste crowd control on a target with Morgana E Black Shield active. To heal with Janna R Monsoon, stay still after casting; if you need to get out immediately, give up the healing and move.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting the first target, so don't overlap with allies or stand in the same line. If Neeko approaches while disguised, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so spread out as soon as you suspect her identity. Don't attack Neeko W Shapesplitter's clone; watch for the real Neeko's position.
Neeko.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Neeko's magic damage, then choose Mercury's Treads. If an allied damage dealer caught by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is likely to die to follow-up attacks, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Neeko.fight: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, trade damage while slowing her with Janna W Zephyr. Save Janna Q Howling Gale to stop Neeko's engage, and time Janna E Eye Of The Storm for when the damage comes in.
Neeko.laning: Stand apart from your allied marksman so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't catch both of you. If Neeko walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Don't enter a bush without vision alone.
Neeko.combo: As Neeko engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock her up, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when an ally takes damage, and knock Neeko back with Janna R Monsoon if she reaches an ally.
Neeko.escape: Right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used, there's a brief chance to step forward and trade damage.
Neeko.phase: In the mid game, use your support item's shields and healing. Late game, give allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Neeko.teamfight: Stay spaced beside your allied damage dealers so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't catch several of you. If disguised Neeko looks ready to close in, spread out early; when she engages, knock her back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. If you need Janna R Monsoon's healing, hold your position after casting; if you need to retreat right away, move after the knockback.

Rell.watch: Stay outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. If you see Rell E Full Tilt speeding up Rell and an ally together, stop trading and back away. Dodge Rell Q Shattering Strike to the side because it breaks shields, and use Janna E Eye Of The Storm after Rell Q Shattering Strike is down.
Rell.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to endure, then choose Mercury's Treads. Rell's main damage is magic damage, so raise your magic resistance first.
Rell.fight: While Rell is mounted, move outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range, and immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt her if she engages. After Rell dismounts, create distance and use Janna Q Howling Gale to stop her movement before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up.
Rell.laning: Save Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr for when your marksman is actually under threat. If Rell walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock her up, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Don't walk alone into areas without vision; ward so you can see Rell's approach early.
Rell.combo: When Rell engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. After Rell Q Shattering Strike is down, cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in, and knock her back with Janna R Monsoon if her engage reaches an ally.
Rell.escape: Don't engage just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; look for the window before Rell E Full Tilt comes back up. If you hit her with Janna Q Howling Gale then, it'll be hard for Rell to escape.
Rell.phase: Early on, Janna has little kill pressure, so focus on stopping Rell's engages and staying alive. Late game, focus on giving allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Rell.teamfight: Spread out from your allies before Rell engages so Rell R Magnet Storm can't pull several of you in. Stay beside your allied damage dealers and stop Rell's engage with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon. If you need healing after Janna R Monsoon knocks her back, hold your position; if you also need to retreat, move immediately.

Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, Pyke E Phantom Undertow can stun you afterward, so keep your distance first.
Pyke.build: Pyke deals physical damage, so build armor if you need resistance. Pyke builds lethality early and targets low-health enemies with Pyke R Death From Below, so prioritize health to stay above its execute threshold rather than adding a little more armor.
Pyke.fight: If Pyke walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm on an ally as the damage comes in, and don't overcommit after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow if Pyke R Death From Below is still available.
Pyke.laning: Save Janna Q Howling Gale for when your marksman is actually under threat, and fire it immediately as Pyke engages. When Pyke backs away, maintain vision to stop healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones, but don't chase him alone into areas without vision. Ward bush approaches to spot Pyke W Ghostwater Dive coming early.
Pyke.combo: When Pyke engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale, slow him with Janna W Zephyr, then cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in. If Pyke reaches an ally and the fight is about to continue, knock him back with Janna R Monsoon. If you also need to retreat, give up the healing and move immediately.
Pyke.escape: If you dodge the stun path of Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, Pyke has used one of his mobility tools. Look to engage during the window before Pyke R Death From Below comes back up, using Janna Q Howling Gale to hold him in place. If Pyke R is still available, don't engage just because Pyke E is down.
Pyke.phase: Early on, Janna should focus on stopping Pyke's engages and staying alive rather than getting kills. Late game, focus on keeping allied damage dealers alive, and spread out low-health allies so Pyke R Death From Below can't hit them together.
Pyke.teamfight: Wait beside your allied damage dealers for Pyke to engage, then interrupt him with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. Keep your distance from low-health allies, since standing too close can put you both in range of Pyke R Death From Below. After knocking him back with Janna R Monsoon, hold still to maintain the cast if you need the healing; if Janna is in danger, move immediately.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance has a visible landing point, so sidestep as soon as the dash starts. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, stop him with Janna Q Howling Gale before he touches you, and avoid standing in a line with your allies.
Rakan.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to raise your magic resistance first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rakan’s threat comes from starting fights with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness more than from damage, so prioritize a way to remove crowd control instead of continuing to stack resistance.
Rakan.fight: Avoid trading while Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield is active, and look for an opening just after it breaks. Once Rakan W Grand Entrance is down, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm on an ally as damage is about to land.
Rakan.laning: Stay beside your ADC, maintain your distance from Rakan, and save Janna Q Howling Gale to stop Rakan W Grand Entrance. When Rakan engages, cast Janna Q Howling Gale immediately and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to end the trade. Don’t enter areas without vision alone, and roam only when the wave has been safely pushed or your ADC has recalled.
Rakan.combo: As Rakan W Grand Entrance comes in, cast Janna Q Howling Gale immediately to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the follow-up damage lands, and use Janna R Monsoon if you need to push his engage back further.
Rakan.escape: The moment after Rakan W Grand Entrance is down is your window to close the distance. If Rakan is separated from his allies and has no one to dash to with Rakan E Battle Dance, look for a chance to catch him with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Rakan.phase: Early on, Janna should focus on stopping Rakan’s engages and staying alive rather than getting kills. In the mid game, protect allies with shields and healing; in the late game, give your damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Rakan.teamfight: Stand right next to your damage dealers, but don’t line up so Rakan R The Quickness can hit you both. As Rakan comes in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, cast Janna Q Howling Gale immediately, then knock him back with Janna R Monsoon when his engage reaches your allies. If healing is needed, use Janna R Monsoon and stay in place; if you also need to escape, give up the healing and move immediately.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so don’t give him range. When Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear to poke, stand behind a minion to reduce the damage. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk outside its landing area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so buy armor items first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Pantheon R Grand Starfall deals two types of damage and penetrates resistances, so don’t rely on resistance alone to survive; avoid its landing area too.
Pantheon.fight: Early on, avoid exchanging blows and stay out of range of Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Pantheon engages, cast Janna Q Howling Gale immediately and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to end the trade. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is facing you, don’t rush to deal damage; wait for it to end or find an angle from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Stay close to your ADC and save Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt Pantheon W Shield Vault. When Pantheon pokes with Q Comet Spear, stand behind a minion and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage lands. Don’t walk alone into areas without vision, and roam only when the wave has been safely pushed or your ADC has recalled.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon engages, cast Janna Q Howling Gale immediately to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Protect your ally with Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage lands. If Pantheon reaches an ally and the fight continues, knock him back with Janna R Monsoon; if you also need to escape, move without waiting for the heal.
Pantheon.escape: Only move forward after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, and don’t rush a chase if Pantheon R Grand Starfall is still available. If both of his mobility abilities are down and Pantheon R Grand Starfall won’t be ready yet, slow him with Janna W Zephyr and knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale to block his escape.
Pantheon.teamfight: Wait beside your damage dealers for Pantheon to engage, and interrupt him first with Janna Q Howling Gale. Knock him back with Janna R Monsoon as he reaches an ally, and keep healing as long as you can stay safely in place. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move outside its landing area.
Pantheon.phase: In the mid game, Janna’s shields and healing grow stronger. In the late game, Pantheon becomes less influential; stop his engages so your damage dealers can stay alive and keep fighting.

Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target it hits and throws them, potentially stunning an ally too, so dodge it from behind minions or your frontline. Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover makes those hit attack nearby allies, so spread out while her ultimate is available. Right after killing an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat with your allies so they can’t fully revive through a takedown.
Renata.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand her damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Renata Glasc deals mostly magic damage, so raise your magic resistance first. If your allied damage dealer is likely to die after being caught by Renata Glasc Q Handshake, prioritize crowd control removal over Janna E Eye Of The Storm and buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Renata.fight: It’s best to close the distance after Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. Use the movement speed and slow from Janna W Zephyr to approach Renata Glasc, then knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Don’t cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm early; cast it on an ally as the damage lands.
Renata.laning: In lane, protect your allied damage dealer and stop Renata Glasc’s engages instead of forcing a kill. Stand behind minions or your frontline so you can dodge Renata Glasc Q Handshake. If an enemy walks in, cast Janna Q Howling Gale immediately, then slow them with Janna W Zephyr. Because Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr cost mana, save them for when an ally is actually at risk of being hit.
Renata.combo: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down and you can close the distance, knock her up first with Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr and stay on her. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as an ally takes damage during the trade. If, out of vision, you’ve anticipated the path Renata Glasc will take, charge Janna Q Howling Gale and release it as she enters that path.
Renata.escape: Once Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, Janna has a chance to close the distance. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so if you get close, knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale to keep her from escaping. When Renata Glasc Q Handshake is available, she can root Janna if Janna approaches first, so dodge it using the frontline.
Renata.phase: In the late game, navigate teamfights by giving your allied damage dealers more time to stay alive.
Renata.teamfight: Stand beside your damage dealers and stop engages started by Renata Glasc Q Handshake with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your allies spaced apart so they don’t advance bunched together in a single line. After knocking enemies back with Janna R Monsoon, hold your position if healing is needed; if you need to retreat immediately, give up the healing and move.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through allies or minions, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace takes time to root after hitting, so dodge it from behind minions; if you’re marked, move away from nearby allies immediately. If Senna hits you once, retreat so she can’t gain mist with a second attack.
Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, so build armor first and pair it with health rather than stacking health alone. If your allied damage dealer is likely to die while rooted by Senna W Last Embrace, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Senna.fight: Look to punish Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul. After dodging Senna W Last Embrace, if you’ve closed the distance, knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr to continue the trade. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm on your allied damage dealer as damage is about to land.
Senna.laning: Watch soul locations in advance and punish Senna when she steps up to collect them to slow her growth. Dodge the straight line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness, but stand behind minions so you can block Senna W Last Embrace. Don’t waste Janna Q Howling Gale on meaningless poke; save it for an engage from Senna’s side or when your allied damage dealer is actually in danger.
Senna.combo: When Senna steps up to collect a soul or after Senna W Last Embrace misses, knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. If Senna has a clear view of your tornado, don’t charge Janna Q Howling Gale for long; cast it immediately. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as an ally takes damage to absorb the trade.
Senna.escape: When Senna W Last Embrace misses, you have a chance to close the distance without worrying about the root. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so once you’re close, it’s hard for her to escape if Janna Q Howling Gale hits. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, don’t engage from there; retreat and move to an area with vision.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has very low health, but Janna also has little kill pressure, so disrupt her soul collection while protecting your allied damage dealer. In the late game, watch out for Senna’s increased range and attack damage, and give your damage dealers time to survive and attack.
Senna.teamfight: Stay beside your damage dealers and watch for the mark from Senna W Last Embrace and Senna E Curse of the Black Mist. If marked, move away from your allies; if you see the mist, retreat to an area with vision or send Janna Q Howling Gale into it. When the enemy engages on your allied damage dealer, knock them back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage lands.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns all allies it hits in a line, so spread out to either side of your allies when Sona steps forward. If Sona moves into attack range as though Sona P Power Chord is ready, expect bonus damage or a slow and create distance.
Sona.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sona deals mostly magic damage, and Janna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to share an aura, force an early trade so Sona has to spend mana on healing. Before Sona E Song of Celerity lets Sona escape, knock Sona up first with Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow Sona with Janna W Zephyr. Protect your ally with Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in.
Sona.laning: Pressure Sona early, before Sona builds stacks, but save Janna Q Howling Gale for when your ADC is actually at risk of being hit. If Sona suddenly moves into attack range, watch for Sona P Power Chord and create distance. Don’t walk alone through areas without vision; secure vision around mid and the jungle entrances.
Sona.combo: As soon as Sona steps forward, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock Sona up, then slow Sona with Janna W Zephyr. Follow up by casting Janna E Eye Of The Storm on your ally as the enemy damage comes in. To charge the tornado for longer, hide it behind a wall or in a bush and fire when Sona enters its path.
Sona.escape: A good window to approach Sona is after Sona R Crescendo misses or has been used. Sona has no skill to create distance, but Sona E Song of Celerity can grant movement speed, so hit Sona with Janna Q Howling Gale first to stop Sona’s movement.
Sona.phase: Early game is the best time to pressure Sona while Sona has no stacks. Sona’s stacks and auras grow stronger over time, so focus on keeping your damage dealers alive later in the game.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies so several of you aren’t hit by Sona R Crescendo, and stay near your damage dealers to stop enemy engages with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon. Knocking Sona away from your group can keep Sona’s healing, shielding, and movement speed auras out of reach. Sona’s healing becomes harder to deal with in long fights, so make sure your team has at least one item that applies Grievous Wounds.

Soraka.watch: If Soraka Q Starcall hits you, Janna is slowed while Soraka gains healing and movement speed, so dodge Q Starcall and keep your distance. Entering Soraka E Equinox’s area silences you and can root you, so move away before stepping into it or use the skills you need beforehand. Soraka R Wish heals allies regardless of distance, so account for it when looking for a kill.
Soraka.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If Soraka’s healing makes fights drag on, consider Grievous Wounds next.
Soraka.fight: The moment Soraka E Equinox is down is your chance to engage. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall while slowing Soraka with Janna W Zephyr, close the distance, then knock Soraka up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm on your ally as the damage comes in.
Soraka.laning: Have your ADC pressure Soraka so Soraka has to use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which costs Soraka health. To keep up the pressure, dodge Soraka Q Starcall. Don’t waste Janna Q Howling Gale on meaningless poke; save it so you can fire immediately when an ally is actually in danger.
Soraka.combo: After confirming that Soraka E Equinox is down, slow Soraka with Janna W Zephyr and fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock Soraka up. Protect your ally with Janna E Eye Of The Storm as they take damage. If there’s no wall or bush to hide the tornado behind, don’t charge Janna Q Howling Gale for long.
Soraka.escape: Soraka has no way to stop your engage after Soraka E Equinox has been used, so go in then. Soraka has no mobility skill, so once you close the distance and hit Soraka with Janna Q Howling Gale, it’s hard for Soraka to escape. Before engaging, dodge Soraka Q Starcall so Soraka can’t gain movement speed.
Soraka.phase: Janna is weak at securing kills early, so protect your allies instead of forcing kills against Soraka’s healing. Later in the game, focus on keeping your damage dealers alive longer.
Soraka.teamfight: Stay beside your damage dealers and knock enemies away with Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon as they engage. If your allies can reach Soraka, help them catch and kill Soraka when Soraka E Equinox is down by slowing Soraka with Janna W Zephyr and knocking Soraka up with Janna Q Howling Gale. Avoid extended fights against enemies receiving Soraka’s healing.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, immediately move out of the line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits a champion, so don’t line up with your allies.
Seraphine.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine’s main damage is magic, so Janna should build magic resistance first. If your damage dealers are likely to die while locked down by crowd control, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Seraphine.fight: The moment Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to close the distance. When Seraphine is alone and separated from an allied ADC, knock Seraphine up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow Seraphine with Janna W Zephyr for a short trade. Keep your distance while Seraphine still has a way to catch you.
Seraphine.laning: In lane, save Janna Q Howling Gale in case your ADC is about to be hit by Seraphine’s engage or Seraphine E Beat Drop. If the enemy actually engages, fire Q immediately and slow them with Janna W Zephyr to end the trade. Don’t use Q or W for meaningless poke or clearing minions, and don’t walk alone through areas without vision.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and Seraphine moves close, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock Seraphine up, then slow Seraphine with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm on your ally as the damage comes in to shield them. If, out of vision, you’ve identified Seraphine’s approach path, you can also charge Q and fire when Seraphine enters its path.
Seraphine.escape: Engage right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop. Seraphine has no mobility skill, so once you close the distance and hit Seraphine with Janna Q Howling Gale, it’s hard for Seraphine to escape. If E is still available or Janna is slowed, prioritize moving out of the line over engaging.
Seraphine.phase: Janna is weak at securing kills early, so focus on avoiding Seraphine’s crowd control and protecting your ADC. Later in the game, focus on giving your damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stand beside your damage dealers and spread out to either side so Seraphine R Encore can’t extend its range through your allies. If the enemy engages on an ally, knock them away with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as the damage comes in. If you only need R’s knockback and Janna also needs to retreat, move immediately without waiting for the healing.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so after dodging the first pass, stay out of its path until it fully disappears. Keep your distance, since Swain Q Death's Hand hits in overlapping bolts at close range. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, don’t keep fighting nearby; move outside its range.
Swain.fight: The moment Swain E Nevermove is down is your chance to start a fight. Slow Swain with Janna W Zephyr and knock Swain up with Janna Q Howling Gale to give your allies time to attack. Swain Q Death's Hand hurts more at close range, so keep your distance in regular trades.
Swain.laning: Dodge the returning path of Swain E Nevermove, and if your ADC is actually about to be hit, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt the follow-up. Time Janna E Eye Of The Storm for the moment damage comes in.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, slow Swain with Janna W Zephyr and knock Swain up with Janna Q Howling Gale. When countering, don’t charge Janna Q Howling Gale: fire immediately, then slow Swain with Janna W Zephyr and create distance. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm as your ally takes damage.
Swain.escape: Engage right after Swain E Nevermove is down. Swain has no skill to create distance or escape, so knocking Swain up with Janna Q Howling Gale then gives your allies a chance to catch Swain. If Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, first move outside its range and wait for it to end.
Swain.phase: Swain is weakest early, before building his scaling stacks, so take lane control then. Later, you’ll be at a disadvantage the longer a fight goes because of Swain’s stacks and healing, so get Grievous Wounds before fighting and protect your damage dealers.
Swain.teamfight: Stay beside your damage dealers, watch for Swain E Nevermove to catch them and for Swain to approach, and interrupt engages with Janna Q Howling Gale. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, knock Swain away with Janna R Monsoon and retreat outside its range until it ends. If you also need Janna R Monsoon’s healing, stay in place after casting; if you need to dodge immediately, move and give up the healing.
Swain.build: Swain deals primarily magic damage, and Janna has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. If an allied damage dealer caught by Swain E Nevermove is focused down and killed, prioritize Mikael’s Blessing.

Taric.watch: Dodge Taric E Dazzle by moving sideways when you see it winding up. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and keep your distance until it ends.
Taric.laning: Do not trade damage at close range with Taric. Poke from range while Taric E Dazzle is on cooldown. Keeping your distance so Taric cannot reach a target for basic attacks also slows his ability rotation through Taric P Bravado. Save Janna Q Howling Gale for when he engages on your ADC, and do not walk alone into areas without vision.
Taric.combo: When Taric walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Follow with Janna E Eye Of The Storm as damage comes in. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, use Janna Q Howling Gale to hold him in place and run out the duration, then attack again after the immunity ends.
Taric.escape: Dodge Taric E Dazzle sideways, then poke or engage while its stun is on cooldown. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have a chance to catch him, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale so he cannot get away.
Taric.phase: Taric's melee damage is strong early, so Janna should keep her distance and stop his engages. In the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Taric.teamfight: Stay near your allied damage dealers and watch for a champion linked to Taric to engage. When they go in, knock them back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, use Janna Q Howling Gale to stop their movement and attack after the immunity ends. If you also need healing from Janna R Monsoon, stay still after casting; if you need to retreat immediately, give up the healing and move.
Taric.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Taric.fight: Dodge Taric E Dazzle, then keep your distance and poke. If Taric approaches, immediately cast Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr so he cannot land basic attacks. Apply a shield with Janna E Eye Of The Storm just as the damage comes in.

Thresh.fight: Immediately after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, close the distance and try to trade. It is also an opportunity when Thresh steps forward to collect souls, but do not move into a position where Thresh E Flay can pull you in. If Thresh engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt him, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr.
Thresh.laning: Do not walk in a straight line; move side to side, and watch especially for Thresh Q Death Sentence when your ADC steps forward to last-hit. Save Janna Q Howling Gale until you need to stop an enemy engage or dive, and time Janna E Eye Of The Storm for when damage comes in. Do not walk alone into areas without vision, and roam only when the wave has been pushed safely or your ADC has recalled.
Thresh.escape: Make Thresh Q Death Sentence miss, then close the distance only while Thresh W Dark Passage is also on cooldown. If you land Janna Q Howling Gale then, Thresh will have a hard time getting away, but avoid angles where Thresh E Flay can pull you in.
Thresh.phase: Janna has low kill pressure early, and Thresh's engage is threatening, so focus on managing your distance and stopping his engages. In the mid game, shields and healing become more valuable; in the late game, contribute to teamfights by keeping allied damage dealers alive longer.
Thresh.teamfight: Wait beside your allied damage dealers for Thresh to engage, then knock him back with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. If you are trapped in Thresh R The Box, immediately choose a wall to break through, and have your toughest ally break through one wall first. When you need Janna R Monsoon to heal as well, hold your position after casting; if you need to escape right away, move after the knockback.
Thresh.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Thresh’s main abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance, but tenacity is also important because Janna is easy to hit with follow-up attacks if she gets caught.
Thresh.combo: As Thresh engages, immediately cast Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Apply a shield with Janna E Eye Of The Storm when the damage comes in, and use Janna R Monsoon to push him away if he keeps engaging.
Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence can lead to follow-up attacks if it hits, so move sideways to dodge when you see him raise his hook. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay cannot pull you toward them. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, decide immediately whether to retreat, as his allies can join the fight.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission splits to both sides even after you dodge the initial projectile, so do not dodge only to the side; move toward Vel'Koz or behind where the beam passed. If Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption also hit in sequence, Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers true damage, so when stacks build up, back off and let them expire. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it immediately with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, you have a chance to close the distance. If you get close, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to give your allies time to attack. Do not force an approach while Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is available, and use Janna E Eye Of The Storm when an ally is actually about to take damage.
Velkoz.laning: Do not use Janna Q Howling Gale for meaningless poke; save it for when Vel'Koz steps forward or an ally is in danger. Manage your distance so Vel'Koz's abilities cannot hit in succession, and secure vision in the river and tri-brush to limit safe spots for Vel'Koz to poke from. Do not walk alone into areas without vision, and roam only when the wave has been pushed safely or your ADC has recalled.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is on cooldown, land Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow him with Janna W Zephyr. If brush or a wall can hide the tornado, charge Janna Q Howling Gale and fire it when Vel'Koz enters its path. If Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts first, prioritize interrupting it with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon over your combo.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility, so the moment after you make Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption miss is your chance to approach. However, if you get too close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you away, so confirm it is on cooldown before landing Janna Q Howling Gale.
Velkoz.phase: Early on, Janna should focus on protecting allies and enduring Vel'Koz's poke and attempts to fight rather than getting kills. In the late game, focus on giving your allied damage dealers time to stay alive and attack.
Velkoz.teamfight: Stay beside your allied damage dealers and watch Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, interrupt it with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon, and use Janna E Eye Of The Storm as an ally is about to take damage. If you also want to heal with Janna R Monsoon, hold your position after casting; if you need to retreat immediately, give up the healing and move.
Velkoz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Build magic resistance first against Vel’Koz’s main abilities, but focus on avoiding repeated hits, since resistance cannot block the true damage from Vel’Koz P Organic Deconstruction or Vel’Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.

Xerath.watch: Xerath E Shocking Orb can set up follow-up magic damage if it stuns you, so watch out most for that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, move well to the side. Also avoid the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction. Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane’s cast animation.
Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Xerath’s main damage is magic, and Janna has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Xerath.fight: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are on cooldown is your chance to close the distance. While Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, dodge to the side and approach him as he slows down. Once close, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to trade.
Xerath.laning: Early on, avoid Xerath’s heavy damage and focus on surviving rather than forcing a kill. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm just as the damage comes in, and use Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr when your ADC is actually in danger. When Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are on cooldown, close the distance and knock him up first with Janna Q Howling Gale. Follow with Janna W Zephyr to slow him, and cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm just as your ally takes damage. If there’s no wall or brush to hide your tornado behind, don’t charge Janna Q Howling Gale for long.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so go in right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used. Use the movement speed from Janna W Zephyr to find an angle, close the distance, then use Janna Q Howling Gale to stop him from getting away.
Xerath.phase: Early on, watch out for Xerath’s long-range poke. Janna has little kill pressure, so focus on surviving and protecting your allies. In the mid game, protect allies with shields and healing; late game, focus on giving your carries time to stay alive and attack.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay beside your carry and move to avoid Xerath E Shocking Orb. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm just as damage comes in. If an enemy engages on an ally, knock them up with Janna Q Howling Gale and, if needed, push them away with Janna R Monsoon. If you need the healing from Janna R Monsoon, hold your position after casting; if Janna needs to escape, give up the healing and move immediately.

Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches twice to the same target, it stuns them, so move away from the ally with the first bomb and get outside its blast radius.
Zilean.fight: If Zilean walks in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to knock him up and slow him with Janna W Zephyr to stop the trade. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm just as an ally takes damage.
Zilean.laning: Don’t use Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna W Zephyr for meaningless poke. Save them for when your ADC is actually about to get hit or when an enemy engages. Secure vision to spot Zilean approaching, and don’t walk alone through areas without vision.
Zilean.combo: When Zilean closes in, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale and slow him with Janna W Zephyr. Then protect your ally with Janna E Eye Of The Storm as they take damage. If Zilean reaches an ally and the fight becomes dangerous, push him away with Janna R Monsoon. If you need the healing, hold your position after casting.
Zilean.escape: Zilean E Time Warp affects only one person at a time, so approach from multiple directions with your allies. If you’ve closed the distance, knock him up with Janna Q Howling Gale.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay beside your carry and watch for Zilean’s bombs and enemy engages. Push away enemies who dive in with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. While an enemy affected by Zilean R Chronoshift is reviving, don’t dump your abilities into them; prepare for the moment they come back. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an enemy carry and makes them hard to kill, switch your focus to the squishy Zilean.
Zilean.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Zilean’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but tenacity has the more immediate benefit when you’re caught by his bomb stun and slow.

Zyra.watch: Zyra E Grasping Roots travels in a straight line and roots you, so dodge sideways near the edge of its range. When you see the summon indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area, and don’t fight where her plants are clustered. If one of Zyra’s abilities comes toward you while you’re going to step on a seed, back away first.
Zyra.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, and Janna has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If your carry keeps dying after being rooted by Zyra E Grasping Roots, get Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Zyra.fight: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots to the side, then close the distance while it’s on cooldown. Zyra can’t create distance on her own, so when you get close, knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. If plants are covering the area, back off briefly and trade once they’re gone.
Zyra.laning: Save Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr for situations where the marksman would actually be hit. If Zyra engages, immediately fire Janna Q Howling Gale to interrupt her and slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Step on seeds to destroy them when it’s safe, and don’t enter brush without vision alone.
Zyra.combo: If Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, approach, knock her up with Janna Q Howling Gale, then slow her with Janna W Zephyr. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm on an ally just as damage comes in to protect them. Only look for a fully charged cast of Janna Q Howling Gale when you can charge it out of sight and keep the tornado hidden.
Zyra.escape: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is on cooldown, that’s your window to close the distance. Zyra has no way to escape on her own, but Janna also has no ability to escape after getting caught, so dodge the root before going in.
Zyra.phase: Early on, Janna should protect her carry by avoiding Zyra’s roots and plant damage rather than starting fights. Shields and healing become more valuable in the mid game; late game, focus on giving your carry time to stay alive and attack.
Zyra.teamfight: Don’t fight in areas where Zyra has stored seeds; move somewhere else. Stay beside your carry and watch the range of Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns. Push away enemies as they engage with Janna Q Howling Gale or Janna R Monsoon. Cast Janna E Eye Of The Storm when an ally takes damage, and cleanse them with Mikael's Blessing if they’re in a situation where Zyra’s crowd control will get them killed.
